Not what I expected. This was a "refurbished" iPhone 11. The packaging was fine, professionally packed with all the included items as described. It had 81% battery life, also as described. However, as I was setting this phone up for my wife, I discovered the screen had been replaced with an "unauthorized" screen. As I was prepared to explain to my wife that the the "big red balloon" with the number 1 in setting was just fine, the phone locked up and would not restart, including a full reboot of the system. Returned to the seller the same day. Let's see if I get a refund properly.
It’s ok. I love how fast the phone is and camera is so clear. But the battery dies quick. My IPhone XR lasts way longer so I’m going to have to replace the battery soon.
Good battery life. Came almost new
It works!!. Face recognition works great and the battery life is good. Lasts for over 24 hours!

Amazing purchase! Don’t hesitate to order!. I love it! No cracks, no scratches, early delivery, 100% battery life, amazing camera and it actually came unlocked. It looks brand new which is amazing considering the price. I 100% recommend this product!
Exactly As Described. As of right now the iPhone is in almost pristine condition. There are tiny scratches in the square camera area but nonetheless is in excellent condition.
Great. Battery life wasn’t too bad 87% figured it would be more but whatever. Overall very good.

Very good. For 2021 the battery has been great, ios is always good and camera is more than good for the average user and very good at night. However if you’re on a budget get an xr for a lot less and basically the same phone with a little bit worse camera. Still awesome buy
Phone works correctly. It was unlucked, was as described. Around the camara it has scratches... but it's in good condition, battery was 90%, it's good.
Good battery life. Good condition. Could not have asked for more.
The battery life didn’t last but a month. No finger print reader, battery life sucks right , there is something’s you can’t do

Not good quality. I got this phone looking in mint condition. However, this was a gift for my gf who stated the battery life kept dropping in less than 30 days. I reported this to Amazon and one of the reps made it hard for me. Still unresolved.
Good. Battery life goes fast

Battery. When the phone arrived it was not charged. I charged to 100% but it didn’t last. After two hours it was at 70%. I’m lucky if the battery lasted for 4 hours until I had to plug it in again. Very disappointed in the product. My advice is to stay away from the seller. The batteries in the phone are terrible. Update: the face recognition stopped working after 3 days.

Very nice phone and excellent camera. This is my husband’s first iPhone and he now loves it. The facial recognition feature is great for him when he’s busy doing projects and cannot use his hands for the fingerprint reader. The battery life is very good, and I’m very impressed with how long the battery lasts especially for an iPhone. Also, the camera is very good and able to take very nice shots. This phone was for my husband, and I definitely want to look at getting one for myself too, now.
It’s alright. Battery life is really good but not a fan of the charger that came with it.
Bad battery life everything else is good. So opened up the packet it was great but the life battery life is truly bad. So I’m getting it replaced.
